subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this split across memory/plugin APIs and channel-specific fixes?
rationale: The request crosses memory authority, persisted rule storage, workspace-file precedence, and channel delivery semantics; current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for the proposed rule layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and cross-channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Narrow Feishu Work
options.body: Use the open Feishu trackers and candidate PRs for message-loss fixes, and track durable rule governance separately if maintainers want that layer.

options.title: Route Through Plugin/API Design
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and cross-channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main and release history touches the memory and Feishu surfaces involved, making this the strongest available routing candidate from local evidence.
